subject: Initial privacy annex request — template exchange & signing options
messages:
From: Alex Palmer <alex.palmer@greenline.co>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greenline Legal <legal@greenline.co>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial request: privacy annex and signing preference

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Greenline is interested in moving forward with Redwood for inference on a pilot. Our legal team asked me to start the DPA/privacy annex conversation so we can scope data flows and confirm signing route. A few quick items to kick off: 

- Can you share your standard DPA/template and an overview of any subprocessors used for hosted inference?
- We need a simple dataflow matrix to show what data is stored/processed and where (US vs EU).
- Do you support DocuSign or Adobe Sign for execution? Our procurement prefers DocuSign but legal is flexible.

Could you send the template and any attachments and let us know expected timeline for review? We aim to get an initial redline back within 7 business days if possible.

Appreciate it — copying legal for visibility.

Best,
Alex Palmer
Head of Integrations, Greenline Health
alex.palmer@greenline.co
+1 415-555-0123
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Palmer <alex.palmer@greenline.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request: privacy annex and signing preference

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and great meeting. Attaching our standard DPA (redwood-dpa-template-v1.docx) and a concise dataflow spreadsheet (greenline-dataflow-diagram.xlsx) that maps controllers/processors and regions. Highlights: 

- Subprocessors: hosting (GCP us-central1), telemetry/monitoring provider (LogStream Inc.), and model delivery CDN (EdgeServe Ltd.). We include subprocessors list in the DPA exhibit; we can provide SOC2 reports on request.
- Transfers: hosted API traffic terminates in the US by default; we can provision a dedicated EU region for EU-residency customers (would require Dedicated/Private options).
- Execution options: we support DocuSign natively and can accept Adobe Sign if Greenline prefers. We typically route for DocuSign to reduce manual signing steps.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Your legal does an initial pass on the DPA and returns redlines.
2) We provision a short call (30 min) with Laura (legal) to walk any non-standard terms (SCCs, audit rights).
3) Confirm signing tool and whether countersignature is required from procurement.

I've looped in Ben (sales) to coordinate timeline. Happy to set up a kickoff call — available Tue/Wed morning PST.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
From: Greenline Legal <legal@greenline.co>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request: privacy annex and signing preference

Mina — thanks for the template. A couple of clarification points from our side before we do a full redline: 

1) Subprocessors: can you confirm whether model weights are ever served from a CDN (EdgeServe) outside the US for cache efficiency? If so, does that create a copy that would be considered a transfer under SCCs?
2) Retention: we need a clear maximum retention period for logs / telemetry associated with requests for compliance assessments (we'd prefer 90 days or less).
3) Audit: our security team requests a SOC2 Type II report and the standard right to an annual third-party audit (subject to reasonable notice).

Also, for signing: procurement prefers DocuSign (Greenline uses enterprise DocuSign). Can we get the DPA as a DocuSign-ready document (no locked fields) and a single-point contact for countersign?

If you can answer the above 3 points, we'll do the redline and aim to return within 5 business days.

Regards,
Greenline Legal
legal@greenline.co
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Greenline Legal <legal@greenline.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request: privacy annex and signing preference

Thanks — quick answers inline and next steps: 

> Subprocessors / CDN copies
EdgeServe is used for serving model artifacts; caches are ephemeral and do not create long-term copies. They are region-bound caches and we can request EU-only caching for your pilot if needed. We will add an explicit clause in the DPA exhibit clarifying "ephemeral caching" and region constraints.

> Retention
Default telemetry/log retention is 180 days. For pilot customers we can offer a 90-day retention policy as a contractable option — I'll mark that in the DPA as an SLA-level parameter.

> Audit
We can provide a SOC 2 Type II report on execution and accept a contractual right for an annual third-party audit with reasonable notice and scope limits (covering only Redwood-processed data and excluding vendor-disclosed trade secrets). Laura can confirm standard language.

Signing: we'll prepare the DocuSign-ready version (no locked fields) and list Ben Carter as the countersign contact for Redwood. Ben is cc'd and will confirm availability for countersignature once the redline is agreed.

Next steps: I'll have Laura update the exhibit and produce a DocuSign-ready copy by EOD tomorrow (17 Nov). If Greenline legal can return redlines by next Wed (25 Nov), we can aim to sign the week of 30 Nov.

Best,
Mina
